headline: JSW Infrastructure Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - JSWINFRA: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of NCR Rail Infrastructure Limited on implementation of the Resolution Plan under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
